claim: Three full-section 5 m cap tests cost an unquoted $0.420–1.558M; use corrected rig reach and direct limits from CHECK-055.
source_report_body: MAINLINE-055 filed, QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. The cheapest test that turns gamma into evidence is three 5 m spherical caps on the true R10 curvature at full cross-section: 5052-O faces 3.10 mm, matched to Be's classical stiffness, on the real CR III 3/8-1.0 core. They are built with the route's seams and a reinforced edge, seeded with 2, 6 and 16 mm pole dimples, and loaded by evacuation plus a water head (sea level reaches gamma 0.593; 5 m of water 0.883). Cost USD 0.42-1.56M; an R30-similar pair adds 0.15-0.61M and a Be confirmation cap 1-4.6M. 038's 1 m foil/foam shells (30-90k) calibrate the elastic FE but cannot measure P2's gamma, because CHECK-029's core shear, face yield and core law are absent. Scaling: the 3/8-1.0 cell cannot shrink without a denser, stronger core, and SR-200 stops at 0.508 mm, so core physics survives only at full thickness. My FE: 5 m caps match the sphere within 1.4%; 5052-O alone keeps the face-yield ratio (0.99), elastic gamma within 3-4%. Adverse pre-test prediction: at 042's 9.3-16.1 mm tolerance the 028b section reaches elastic gamma 0.47-0.51, and its core passes CR III shear strength at 25-38 kPa. Gamma 0.564 needs dimples of at most 5.8 mm, the core 2.4 mm, the faces 1.3 mm. The outcome table maps each gamma band to R10/R30. Three articles per configuration discriminate models; statistical bounds need far more, so results count through a validated FE. First: the dimple specification, 038 T1, core witnesses, rig safety. Twelve NFI. Next: none.
numerical_scope: Synthesis of attributed reports; consult named check/review findings for numerical disposition
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma.
